reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing getMonthWideCategories selection used by five actions, but copyPreviousMonth keeps deciding the hidden rule in its own loop instead of in getBudgetData, which already applies the other exclusions.

duplication.why: The hidden-category rule and its new override are expressed twice: as an SQL fragment in getMonthWideCategories and as an inline condition in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The flag lands in the shared selection for most actions, but for copyPreviousMonth it sits in the action body rather than the selection layer.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing for month-wide actions is changed.

maintainability.why: Straightforward and consistent across actions, though a future change to the hidden rule still needs editing in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth applies `!includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden)` locally instead of letting getBudgetData (which already applies the template and #fixed exclusions) decide hidden categories.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden rule appears as a conditional SQL fragment in getMonthWideCategories and as a JS boolean check in copyPreviousMonth: the same rule reshaped across two layers.
